name: Lion Social Share
author: lionwp

sections.description:
Lion Social Share is a powerful and beautiful social sharing plugin that helps increase your content’s reach across 40+ social networks.

Key Features:

  • 40+ Social Networks – Facebook, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, WhatsApp, Telegram, Reddit, TikTok, Discord, Slack, and many more
  • 10 Button Styles – Rounded, Square, Circle, Pill, Leaf, Hexagon, Diamond, Gradient, Outline, and Minimal
  • 3 Size Options – Small, Medium, and Large
  • Sticky Sidebar – Floating share buttons that follow users as they scroll
  • Auto Placement – Automatically add buttons before, after, or both sides of content
  • Widget Support – Add share buttons to any widget area
  • Shortcode Support – Use shortcodes anywhere in your content
  • Drag and Drop Ordering – Easily reorder networks in admin
  • Mobile Responsive – Looks great on all devices
  • Clean Modern Design – Beautiful orange and dark theme

Shortcode Examples:

Basic usage with default settings:
[lion_social_share]

With specific style:
[lion_social_share style=”pill”]

With specific networks:
[lion_social_share networks=”facebook,twitter,linkedin”]

With size and labels:
[lion_social_share size=”large” labels=”yes”]

Supported Networks:

Facebook, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Pinterest, WhatsApp, Telegram, Email, Reddit, Tumblr, Messenger, Viber, LINE, Skype, Snapchat, TikTok, Discord, Slack, YouTube, Instagram, Threads, Mastodon, Bluesky, VKontakte, Weibo, XING, Buffer, Flipboard, Hacker News, Digg, Evernote, Instapaper, Blogger, LiveJournal, Douban, Renren, Print, Copy Link, SMS, WeChat, QZone, Odnoklassniki

External services

Lion Social Share displays “share” buttons for 35+ social networks and bookmarking services. Each button is a plain link to that service’s own public share page, built entirely in the visitor’s browser – the plugin’s PHP code never contacts any of these services itself, and nothing is sent unless a visitor deliberately clicks a button.

When a visitor clicks a share button, their browser is sent to the chosen service’s share page with the current page’s URL and title included in the link’s query string (Pinterest’s button also includes the URL of the post’s featured image, so the destination page can show a preview). This is the same information already publicly visible on the page being shared. No visitor data is collected or transmitted by this plugin itself; the browser navigation happens directly between the visitor and the third-party service they chose to click.

The “Copy Link”, “SMS”, and “Email” buttons do not contact any external service – they copy text locally, or open the visitor’s own device apps (SMS/mail client).

Below is every social network this plugin can link to, with that service’s own Terms of Service and Privacy Policy:

  • Facebook / Messenger – Terms, Privacy
  • X (Twitter) – Terms, Privacy
  • LinkedIn – Terms, Privacy
  • Pinterest – Terms, Privacy
  • WhatsApp – Terms, Privacy
  • Telegram – Terms, Privacy
  • Reddit – Terms, Privacy
  • Tumblr – Terms, Privacy
  • Viber – Terms, Privacy
  • LINE – Terms, Privacy
  • Skype (Microsoft) – Terms, Privacy
  • Snapchat – Terms, Privacy
  • TikTok – Terms, Privacy
  • Discord – Terms, Privacy
  • Slack – Terms, Privacy
  • YouTube / Blogger (Google) – Terms, Privacy
  • Instagram / Threads (Meta) – Terms, Privacy
  • Mastodon – shared via the independent tool mastodonshare.com; Mastodon’s own terms and privacy policy apply once you reach your chosen instance
  • Bluesky – Terms, Privacy
  • VKontakte – Terms, Privacy
  • Weibo – Terms & Privacy
  • XING – Terms, Privacy
  • Buffer – Terms, Privacy
  • Flipboard – Terms, Privacy
  • Hacker News (Y Combinator) – Terms & Privacy
  • Digg – Terms, Privacy
  • Evernote – Terms, Privacy
  • Instapaper – Terms, Privacy
  • LiveJournal – Terms, Privacy
  • Douban – Terms & Privacy
  • Renren – Terms & Privacy
  • PrintFriendly – Terms, Privacy
  • QZone (Tencent) – Privacy
  • Odnoklassniki – Terms, Privacy
  • WeChat – button reserved for a future release; it does not link anywhere yet

Privacy Policy

Lion Social Share does not collect, store, or transmit any visitor or site data. Share buttons simply link out to the social network the visitor chooses to click – no tracking scripts, cookies, or analytics are added by this plugin, and the plugin never contacts any external server.

For more information, see our Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/lion-social-share directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the Lion Social menu to configure the plugin.
  4. Use the shortcode [lion_social_share] to display buttons in your content.
sections.faq:
How do I add share buttons to my posts?

You can either enable “Auto add to posts” in the Placement settings, use the shortcode [lion_social_share], or add the widget to a sidebar.

Can I customize which networks appear?

Yes! Go to Lion Social > Networks and check/uncheck the networks you want to display. You can also drag and drop to reorder them.

How do I use the sticky sidebar?

Go to Lion Social > Sticky Sidebar, enable the feature, choose left or right position, and select which networks to display.

Can I use different styles on different pages?

Yes! Use the shortcode with the style attribute: [lion_social_share style="hexagon"]

Is this plugin GDPR compliant?

Yes. This plugin does not collect or store any visitor data. Share buttons only activate when clicked by the user.
